strings.brand.tagline: Local WYSIWYG Markdown with an embedded MCP server
strings.format.row: Add a row to the table
strings.format.column: Add a column to the table
strings.title.source: Show raw Markdown for the whole document (Ctrl+/)
strings.agent.connectionHint: Any MCP-capable Agent (OpenClaw, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, ...) can connect to this endpoint. Nothing else on this machine can, unless it has the token.
strings.agent.bridgeLabel: stdio bridge command (for hosts that launch a process)
strings.agent.allowWrite: Allow agents to modify this document
strings.agent.requireConfirmation: Require diff confirmation for every agent change
strings.agent.allowSave: Allow agents to save to disk
strings.agent.portTitle: 0 = pick a free port and remember it
strings.agent.portInvalidBody: Use a number between 0 and 65535 (0 = automatic).
strings.agent.portSavedBody: The editor will use port {0} from the next start on.
strings.agent.keepToken: Keep the token across restarts (same endpoint every time)
strings.agent.endpointPinned: Pinned: this endpoint stays valid after a restart (port {0}).
strings.agent.endpointEphemeral: Port {0} is remembered, but a new token is generated on every start.
strings.agent.allowRollback: Allow agents to roll back changes
strings.agent.allowCaret: Allow agents to move the caret / selection
strings.agent.allowedDirectory: Only allow saving inside this directory (empty = unset)
strings.audit.hint: Every change is recorded with who made it, which tool, and what changed. Rolling back creates a new audited edit, so nothing is ever lost.
strings.audit.noAgentChanges: No agent changes to roll back
strings.diff.title: Agent proposes a change
strings.diff.banner: An Agent is waiting for your confirmation: {0}
strings.toast.copiedBody: The value is on your clipboard.
strings.toast.copyManuallyBody: Select the field and press Ctrl+C.
strings.toast.sourceModeBody: The whole document is shown as raw Markdown.
strings.toast.wysiwygModeBody: Your caret line shows the source, the rest renders.
strings.toast.changeAppliedBody: The agent proposal is now part of the document.
strings.toast.noHostBody: Running without the desktop shell: editing is local to this page.
strings.editor.empty: Start writing, or open a Markdown file.
